user_saw: A write-scoped client could submit input as restart recovery and make its own request wait for a busy Codex thread for up to two minutes.
summary: The gateway now rejects restart recovery provenance on agent RPC requests from non-backend callers.
reasoning: The agent RPC already passed through caller-supplied provenance before #187157. That commit made the embedded runner use the restart marker to preserve an unanswered user message, so the existing pass-through let callers select recovery-specific behavior. I also checked #201761, which later used the same marker to let restart input wait for an active Codex turn.
